'''Santa is Coming Soon!''' (Japanese: '''もうすぐサンタがやってくる！''' ''Mō Sugu Santa ga Yattekuru!'') is one of the ending songs of the Japanese [[Pikachu short]]s.

It debuted in ''[[PK08|Delibird's Dilemma]]''.
